headline: Asian Stocks August 18 – Far East Seeks Direction as Oil Price Stands at $91
summary: Asian exchanges largely weakened on Tuesday, with Japanese shares closing sharply lower and Japanese government bonds rising to a three-decade high. Oil was priced at $91.
why: Japan's Nikkei 225 is the main benchmark for the region's largest equity market, and JGB prices influence global bond yields and yen funding.
why_moved: Japanese stocks closed with a sharp plunge while Japanese government bonds rallied to a three-decade high, and most other Asian exchanges weakened.
